title: Extract nested ternary operations into independent statements across all files (~44 instances)
description:
## Source
SonarQube static analysis audit (`Data/Pages/audits/ms-sonar-static-analysis-7-26-26.md`)

## Findings
~44 instances of nested ternary expressions across all files that should be extracted into independent if/else statements:

**Razor Pages (~24 instances):** `Admin.razor` (L776×2, L780, L793, L795, L1513, L1876), `Chat.razor` (L542, L2801, L3011, L3016), `HealthStats.razor` (L341), `MemoryViewer.razor` (L853, L1032), `Models.razor` (L138), `Proposals.razor` (L344, L720, L766), `TagManager.razor.cs` (L104, L118, L213, L219), `Tasks.razor` (L643), `TrainingWorkbench.razor` (L113, L114, L864), `SensitiveValue.razor` (L26)

**Services (~20 instances):** `ChatServices.cs` (L3081, L3083, L3085, L3091, L3107, L3109, L3208, L3210), `PageService.cs` (L40, L136, L138, L160), `TaskDomainService.cs` (L452-456), `ChatMarkdownRenderer.cs` (L328), `AdminSettingsService.cs` (L468), `ChatContextPlanner.cs` (L85), `ChatReferenceLinkPolicy.cs` (L258), `MaintenanceAgentServices.cs` (L1630), `MemoryContextPackFormatter.cs` (L115), `VarResolver.cs` (L91), `TrainingHarnessRunnerService.cs` (L31, L33, L35)

## Impact
Nested ternaries reduce readability, increase cognitive load, and are hard to debug. Each should be extracted into explanatory intermediate variables or if/else blocks.

## Action Required
Replace each nested ternary with explanatory intermediate variables or if/else statements. Decompose complex boolean logic into named local variables for clarity.

## Effort
~2h10min

## Priority
P1 — Maintainability
